<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Escape Room Logístico · Operación Compras Estratégicas</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
  <script>
    tailwind.config = {
      theme: {
        extend: {
          fontFamily: {
            display: ['Inter', 'ui-sans-serif', 'system-ui']
          },
          boxShadow: {
            neon: '0 0 30px rgba(34,211,238,.28)',
            lime: '0 0 30px rgba(163,230,53,.24)',
            violet: '0 0 30px rgba(168,85,247,.24)'
          }
        }
      }
    }
  </script>
  <style>
    html { scroll-behavior:smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .glass {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,23,42,.82), rgba(30,41,59,.68));
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    }
    .light-glass {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.94), rgba(240,249,255,.88));
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(14,165,233,.18);
    }
    .scene {
      display:none;
      animation: sceneIn .55s ease both;
    }
    .scene.active { display:block; }
    @keyframes sceneIn {
      from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(16px) scale(.985); }
      to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1); }
    }
    .pulse-ring { animation:pulseRing 2s infinite; }
    @keyframes pulseRing {
      0%,100% { box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,211,238,.38); }
      50% { box-shadow:0 0 0 16px rgba(34,211,238,0); }
    }
    .floaty { animation:floaty 4.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
    @keyframes floaty {
      0%,100% { transform:translateY(0); }
      50% { transform:translateY(-12px); }
    }
    .truck { animation:truckMove 12s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes truckMove {
      0% { transform:translateX(-180px); }
      100% { transform:translateX(calc(100vw + 220px)); }
    }
    .belt-box { animation:belt 8s linear infinite; }
    .belt-box.b2 { animation-delay:-2.2s; }
    .belt-box.b3 { animation-delay:-4.4s; }
    @keyframes belt {
      from { transform:translateX(-140px); }
      to { transform:translateX(calc(100vw + 160px)); }
    }
    .scan { animation:scanLine 3s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes scanLine {
      0% { transform:translateY(-110%); opacity:0; }
      20%,80% { opacity:.7; }
      100% { transform:translateY(650%); opacity:0; }
    }
    .shake { animation:shake .35s ease; }
    @keyframes shake {
      0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}
      25%{transform:translateX(-7px)}
      75%{transform:translateX(7px)}
    }
    .success-pop { animation:successPop .55s ease; }
    @keyframes successPop {
      0%{transform:scale(.86);opacity:.3}
      65%{transform:scale(1.04)}
      100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}
    }
    .dropzone.drag-over {
      outline:3px dashed rgba(34,211,238,.7);
      transform:scale(1.015);
    }
    .draggable { cursor:grab; user-select:none; }
    .draggable:active { cursor:grabbing; }
    .locked {
      filter:grayscale(1);
      opacity:.45;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .timer-danger { animation:dangerPulse .8s infinite alternate; }
    @keyframes dangerPulse {
      from { color:#fff; }
      to { color:#fb7185; text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(251,113,133,.75); }
    }
    .modal-bg { background:rgba(2,6,23,.72); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); }
    .progress-fill { transition:width .45s ease; }
    .choice.selected {
      border-color:rgb(34 211 238);
      box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(34,211,238,.22), 0 0 25px rgba(34,211,238,.18);
    }
    .choice.correct {
      border-color:rgb(34 197 94);
      background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);
    }
    .choice.wrong {
      border-color:rgb(244 63 94);
      background:rgba(244,63,94,.12);
    }
    .badge-glow { text-shadow:0 0 14px currentColor; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *,*::before,*::after { animation-duration:.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="min-h-screen text-slate-100 bg-slate-950">
  <audio id="bgMusic" loop preload="auto" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,"></audio>

  <!-- Animated logistics backdrop -->
  <div class="fixed inset-0 -z-20 overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-950 via-slate-950 to-violet-950">
    <div class="absolute -top-32 -left-32 w-[28rem] h-[28rem] rounded-full bg-cyan-500/20 blur-3xl"></div>
    <div class="absolute top-1/3 -right-32 w-[30rem] h-[30rem] rounded-full bg-fuchsia-500/15 blur-3xl"></div>
    <div class="absolute bottom-[-9rem] left-1/3 w-[28rem] h-[28rem] rounded-full bg-lime-400/10 blur-3xl"></div>
    <div class="absolute inset-0 opacity-[.08]" style="background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.12) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.12) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:48px 48px;"></div>

    <svg class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-44 opacity-40" viewBox="0 0 1600 180" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="road" x1="0" x2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0ea5e9"/>
          <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#8b5cf6"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#84cc16"/>
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <rect x="0" y="118" width="1600" height="62" fill="#020617"/>
      <rect x="0" y="127" width="1600" height="4" fill="url(#road)" opacity=".8"/>
      <g fill="#0f172a" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2">
        <rect x="80" y="40" width="300" height="78" rx="8"/>
        <rect x="430" y="15" width="320" height="103" rx="8"/>
        <rect x="790" y="50" width="250" height="68" rx="8"/>
        <rect x="1080" y="28" width="360" height="90" rx="8"/>
      </g>
      <g fill="#38bdf8" opacity=".55">
        <rect x="115" y="62" width="48" height="38"/><rect x="177" y="62" width="48" height="38"/><rect x="239" y="62" width="48" height="38"/>
        <rect x="470" y="42" width="52" height="52"/><rect x="538" y="42" width="52" height="52"/><rect x="606" y="42" width="52" height="52"/>
        <rect x="1115" y="50" width="54" height="46"/><rect x="1184" y="50" width="54" height="46"/><rect x="1253" y="50" width="54" height="46"/>
      </g>
    </svg>

    <svg class="truck absolute bottom-7 left-0 w-40 h-20 opacity-80" viewBox="0 0 220 100" aria-hidden="true">
      <rect x="12" y="22" width="125" height="52" rx="8" fill="#22d3ee"/>
      <path d="M138 38h36l25 22v14h-61z" fill="#a3e635"/>
      <rect x="150" y="45" width="22" height="13" rx="2" fill="#0f172a"/>
      <circle cx="55" cy="80" r="14" fill="#020617"/><circle cx="55" cy="80" r="6" fill="#94a3b8"/>
      <circle cx="166" cy="80" r="14" fill="#020617"/><circle cx="166" cy="80" r="6" fill="#94a3b8"/>
    </svg>

    <div class="absolute top-24 inset-x-0 h-16 overflow-hidden opacity-25">
      <div class="belt-box absolute top-2 left-0 w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-amber-300 shadow-xl"></div>
      <div class="belt-box b2 absolute top-2 left-0 w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-fuchsia-400 shadow-xl"></div>
      <div class="belt-box b3 absolute top-2 left-0 w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-cyan-300 shadow-xl"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Header -->
  <header class="sticky top-0 z-30 border-b border-white/10 bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-xl">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-3">
      <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center gap-3 lg:gap-5">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[.26em] text-cyan-300 font-extrabold">Gestión Logística Estratégica</div>
            <h1 class="font-black text-lg md:text-xl leading-tight">ESCAPE ROOM · Operación Compras Estratégicas</h1>
          </div>
          <button id="soundBtn" class="lg:hidden px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 transition" title="Activar/desactivar sonido">🔊</button>
        </div>

        <div class="flex-1">
          <div class="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1 text-slate-300">
            <span id="progressLabel">0 de 6 habitaciones</span>
            <span id="scoreTop">100 pts</span>
          </div>
          <div class="h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden">
            <div id="progressBar" class="progress-fill h-full w-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 via-fuchsia-400 to-lime-400"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex gap-2 items-center justify-between lg:justify-end">
          <div id="timerBox" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/15 border border-rose-400/25 min-w-[110px] text-center">
            <div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-rose-200">Tiempo</div>
            <div id="timer" class="font-black tabular-nums text-xl">15:00</div>
          </div>
          <button id="hintGlobal" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-black hover:brightness-110 transition">💡 Pista</button>
          <button id="soundBtnDesk" class="hidden lg:block px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 transition" title="Activar/desactivar sonido">🔊</button>
          <button id="resetBtn" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-rose-500/20 transition" title="Reiniciar todo">↻</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-7 md:py-10">

    <!-- Start -->
    <section id="startScreen" class="scene active">
      <div class="grid lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_.9fr] gap-6 items-stretch">
        <div class="glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 md:p-9 shadow-neon relative overflow-hidden">
          <div class="scan absolute left-0 right-0 h-px bg-cyan-300/80"></div>
          <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold bg-cyan-400/15 border border-cyan-300/25 text-cyan-200">MISIÓN ACADÉMICA · 15 MIN</span>
          <h2 class="mt-5 text-4xl md:text-6xl font-black leading-[.98]">Recupera el <span class="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-300 via-fuchsia-300 to-lime-300">Tablero Maestro</span> de Compras.</h2>
          <p class="mt-5 text-slate-300 text-lg leading-relaxed max-w-3xl">
            Un fallo en el sistema ha mezclado estructuras, funciones y datos de gasto. Supera 6 habitaciones para reconstruir la lógica de Compras y desbloquear el acceso al siguiente nivel estratégico.
          </p>

          <div class="grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 mt-7">
            <div class="rounded-2xl bg-white/7 border border-white/10 p-4">
              <div class="text-2xl">🔐</div><div class="font-bold mt-2">6 escenas</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400">Cada una desbloquea la siguiente.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="rounded-2xl bg-white/7 border border-white/10 p-4">
              <div class="text-2xl">💡</div><div class="font-bold mt-2">Pistas opcionales</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400">Cada pista cuesta 5 puntos.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="rounded-2xl bg-white/7 border border-white/10 p-4">
              <div class="text-2xl">🏆</div><div class="font-bold mt-2">Certificado PDF</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400">Nombre, puntuación y desempeño.</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="mt-8 grid sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] gap-3">
            <input id="studentName" maxlength="60" class="w-full rounded-2xl bg-white text-slate-900 px-5 py-4 font-semibold outline-none ring-0 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-cyan-400/30" placeholder="Escribe tu nombre y apellido" />
            <button id="startBtn" class="pulse-ring rounded-2xl px-7 py-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-lime-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-lg hover:scale-[1.02] transition">INICIAR MISIÓN →</button>
          </div>
          <p id="nameError" class="hidden mt-2 text-rose-300 text-sm font-semibold">Escribe tu nombre para iniciar.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="light-glass rounded-[2rem] p-5 md:p-7 text-slate-900 overflow-hidden relative">
          <div class="absolute -top-14 -right-14 w-40 h-40 bg-fuchsia-300/30 rounded-full blur-2xl"></div>
          <h3 class="font-black text-2xl">Centro de Operaciones</h3>
          <p class="text-slate-600 mt-1">Mapa de la misión</p>
          <div class="mt-6 space-y-3" id="roomMap"></div>
          <div class="mt-6 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-white p-4">
            <div class="text-cyan-300 font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">Regla de puntuación</div>
            <div class="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-300">Base: 100 puntos. −5 por pista usada, −2 por intento incorrecto. El puntaje mínimo final es 1.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Room 1 -->
    <section id="scene1" class="scene">
      <div class="grid lg:grid-cols-[.85fr_1.15fr] gap-6">
        <aside class="glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 relative overflow-hidden">
          <div class="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 rounded-bl-full bg-cyan-400/15"></div>
          <div class="text-cyan-300 font-black text-xs tracking-[.25em]">HABITACIÓN 01</div>
          <h2 class="text-3xl font-black mt-2">El Centro de Mando</h2>
          <p class="mt-4 text-slate-300">Tres estructuras compiten por tomar el control. Selecciona la que corresponde a cada escenario.</p>
          <svg class="w-full mt-5 floaty" viewBox="0 0 420 250" aria-hidden="true">
            <rect x="35" y="35" width="350" height="175" rx="22" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#22d3ee" stroke-width="3"/>
            <rect x="65" y="67" width="84" height="105" rx="12" fill="#164e63"/>
            <rect x="168" y="67" width="84" height="105" rx="12" fill="#581c87"/>
            <rect x="271" y="67" width="84" height="105" rx="12" fill="#365314"/>
            <path d="M107 172v24m103-24v24m103-24v24M107 196h206" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <circle cx="210" cy="196" r="14" fill="#facc15"/>
          </svg>
          <button class="hintBtn mt-3 w-full rounded-xl border border-amber-300/30 bg-amber-300/10 text-amber-200 py-3 font-bold" data-room="1">💡 Usar pista (−5)</button>
        </aside>
        <div class="light-glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 md:p-8 text-slate-900">
          <h3 class="font-black text-2xl">Puzzle: ¿Quién gobierna la compra?</h3>
          <p class="text-slate-600 mt-2">Elige una estructura para cada caso.</p>
          <div id="r1Questions" class="space-y-5 mt-6"></div>
          <button class="checkBtn mt-7 w-full rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-white py-4 font-black hover:bg-cyan-700 transition" data-room="1">VALIDAR CONFIGURACIÓN</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Room 2 -->
    <section id="scene2" class="scene">
      <div class="glass rounded-[2rem] p-5 md:p-8">
        <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <div class="text-fuchsia-300 font-black text-xs tracking-[.25em]">HABITACIÓN 02</div>
            <h2 class="text-3xl font-black mt-2">La Sala de Funciones</h2>
            <p class="text-slate-300 mt-2 max-w-3xl">Clasifica cada actividad en la función correcta: Sourcing, Transaccional o Gerencial.</p>
          </div>
          <button class="hintBtn rounded-xl border border-amber-300/30 bg-amber-300/10 text-amber-200 px-4 py-3 font-bold" data-room="2">💡 Pista (−5)</button>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-7 grid lg:grid-cols-[.8fr_1.2fr] gap-5">
          <div class="rounded-3xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 p-4">
            <div class="font-bold mb-3">Actividades por clasificar</div>
            <div id="r2Cards" class="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-1 gap-3"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div class="dropzone rounded-3xl p-4 bg-cyan-400/10 border-2 border-cyan-300/30 min-h-[300px]" data-zone="sourcing">
              <div class="text-cyan-200 font-black text-xl">🔎 Sourcing</div>
              <div class="text-xs text-cyan-100/70 mt-1">Análisis, mercado, negociación, contratación.</div>
              <div class="drop-content mt-4 space-y-2"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="dropzone rounded-3xl p-4 bg-fuchsia-400/10 border-2 border-fuchsia-300/30 min-h-[300px]" data-zone="transaccional">
              <div class="text-fuchsia-200 font-black text-xl">⚙️ Transaccional</div>
              <div class="text-xs text-fuchsia-100/70 mt-1">Requisiciones, órdenes, recepciones, facturas.</div>
              <div class="drop-content mt-4 space-y-2"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="dropzone rounded-3xl p-4 bg-lime-400/10 border-2 border-lime-300/30 min-h-[300px]" data-zone="gerencial">
              <div class="text-lime-200 font-black text-xl">📊 Gerencial</div>
              <div class="text-xs text-lime-100/70 mt-1">Políticas, estrategia, presupuesto, indicadores y riesgos.</div>
              <div class="drop-content mt-4 space-y-2"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button class="checkBtn mt-6 w-full rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 to-cyan-500 py-4 font-black" data-room="2">COMPROBAR CLASIFICACIÓN</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Room 3 -->
    <section id="scene3" class="scene">
      <div class="grid lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_.95fr] gap-6">
        <div class="light-glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 md:p-8 text-slate-900">
          <div class="text-rose-600 font-black text-xs tracking-[.25em]">HABITACIÓN 03</div>
          <h2 class="text-3xl font-black mt-2">Alerta de Segregación</h2>
          <p class="text-slate-600 mt-2">Una persona concentra demasiadas actividades críticas. Marca todas las acciones que incrementan el riesgo cuando se concentran en la misma persona.</p>
          <div id="r3Options" class="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-6"></div>
          <button class="checkBtn mt-6 w-full rounded-2xl bg-rose-600 text-white py-4 font-black hover:bg-rose-700" data-room="3">DESACTIVAR RIESGO</button>
        </div>

        <aside class="glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 overflow-hidden relative">
          <div class="absolute inset-0 opacity-20">
            <svg class="w-full h-full" viewBox="0 0 500 500" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" aria-hidden="true">
              <circle cx="250" cy="250" r="150" fill="none" stroke="#fb7185" stroke-width="5"/>
              <circle cx="250" cy="250" r="95" fill="none" stroke="#facc15" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="11 8"/>
              <path d="M250 70L430 390H70Z" fill="none" stroke="#fb7185" stroke-width="4"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="relative">
            <div class="text-5xl">🚨</div>
            <h3 class="font-black text-2xl mt-3">Señal de control</h3>
            <p class="text-slate-300 mt-3">Cuando una sola persona puede crear al proveedor, seleccionarlo, emitir la orden, confirmar recepción, aprobar factura y autorizar pago, el riesgo de error, favoritismo o fraude aumenta significativamente.</p>
            <button class="hintBtn mt-5 w-full rounded-xl border border-amber-300/30 bg-amber-300/10 text-amber-200 py-3 font-bold" data-room="3">💡 Pista (−5)</button>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Room 4 -->
    <section id="scene4" class="scene">
      <div class="glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 md:p-8">
        <div class="grid lg:grid-cols-[.8fr_1.2fr] gap-6 items-start">
          <div>
            <div class="text-lime-300 font-black text-xs tracking-[.25em]">HABITACIÓN 04</div>
            <h2 class="text-3xl font-black mt-2">El Laboratorio del Gasto</h2>
            <p class="text-slate-300 mt-3">Reconstruye el proceso de Spend Analysis en el orden lógico indicado por su definición.</p>
            <div class="mt-6 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 bg-slate-900">
              <svg class="w-full" viewBox="0 0 700 270" aria-hidden="true">
                <rect width="700" height="270" fill="#020617"/>
                <g opacity=".25" stroke="#22d3ee"><path d="M0 50h700M0 105h700M0 160h700M0 215h700"/></g>
                <g fill="#38bdf8"><rect x="75" y="150" width="65" height="70" rx="8"/><rect x="165" y="110" width="65" height="110" rx="8"/><rect x="255" y="75" width="65" height="145" rx="8"/></g>
                <g fill="#a3e635"><rect x="390" y="125" width="65" height="95" rx="8"/><rect x="480" y="90" width="65" height="130" rx="8"/><rect x="570" y="45" width="65" height="175" rx="8"/></g>
                <path d="M62 228H650" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              </svg>
            </div>
            <button class="hintBtn mt-5 w-full rounded-xl border border-amber-300/30 bg-amber-300/10 text-amber-200 py-3 font-bold" data-room="4">💡 Pista (−5)</button>
          </div>
          <div class="light-glass rounded-3xl p-5 text-slate-900">
            <div class="font-black text-lg">Ordena los 4 pasos</div>
            <p class="text-sm text-slate-600 mt-1">Usa ↑ y ↓ para reorganizar.</p>
            <div id="r4List" class="space-y-3 mt-5"></div>
            <button class="checkBtn mt-6 w-full rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-white py-4 font-black" data-room="4">EJECUTAR ANÁLISIS</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Room 5 -->
    <section id="scene5" class="scene">
      <div class="light-glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 md:p-8 text-slate-900">
        <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-end justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div class="text-violet-700 font-black text-xs tracking-[.25em]">HABITACIÓN 05</div>
            <h2 class="text-3xl font-black mt-2">Radar de Spend Analysis</h2>
            <p class="text-slate-600 mt-2">Relaciona cada evidencia con el concepto correcto.</p>
          </div>
          <button class="hintBtn rounded-xl border border-amber-500/25 bg-amber-300/30 text-amber-900 px-4 py-3 font-bold" data-room="5">💡 Pista (−5)</button>
        </div>
        <div id="r5Questions" class="grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-6"></div>
        <button class="checkBtn mt-6 w-full rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-700 to-fuchsia-600 text-white py-4 font-black" data-room="5">CALIBRAR RADAR</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Room 6 -->
    <section id="scene6" class="scene">
      <div class="grid lg:grid-cols-[1.15fr_.85fr] gap-6">
        <div class="glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 md:p-9 relative overflow-hidden">
          <div class="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-72 h-72 rounded-full bg-lime-400/10 blur-3xl"></div>
          <div class="text-lime-300 font-black text-xs tracking-[.25em]">HABITACIÓN 06 · PUERTA FINAL</div>
          <h2 class="text-4xl font-black mt-2">Código Kraljic</h2>
          <p class="text-slate-300 mt-3">Has organizado funciones y depurado la lectura del gasto. Ahora identifica el siguiente tema del módulo para abrir la puerta final.</p>
          <div class="mt-6 grid gap-3" id="r6Choices"></div>
          <button class="checkBtn mt-6 w-full rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-lime-400 to-cyan-400 text-slate-950 py-4 font-black" data-room="6">DESBLOQUEAR PUERTA</button>
          <button class="hintBtn mt-3 w-full rounded-xl border border-amber-300/30 bg-amber-300/10 text-amber-200 py-3 font-bold" data-room="6">💡 Pista (−5)</button>
        </div>

        <div class="light-glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 text-slate-900 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[380px]">
          <div class="text-center">
            <div class="relative mx-auto w-64 h-64">
              <div class="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-[14px] border-slate-200"></div>
              <div class="absolute inset-5 rounded-full border-[5px] border-dashed border-violet-500 animate-spin" style="animation-duration:14s"></div>
              <div class="absolute inset-14 rounded-full bg-slate-950 grid place-items-center text-white shadow-2xl">
                <div>
                  <div class="text-4xl">🔒</div>
                  <div class="font-black mt-2">ACCESO</div>
                  <div class="text-xs text-cyan-300">NIVEL 11</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="font-black text-xl mt-5">La estrategia correcta abre la puerta.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- End -->
    <section id="endScreen" class="scene">
      <div class="light-glass rounded-[2rem] p-6 md:p-10 text-slate-900 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div class="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-72 h-72 bg-cyan-300/35 rounded-full blur-3xl"></div>
        <div class="absolute -bottom-24 -left-24 w-72 h-72 bg-fuchsia-300/25 rounded-full blur-3xl"></div>
        <div class="relative grid lg:grid-cols-[.95fr_1.05fr] gap-8 items-center">
          <div>
            <span class="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-lime-200 text-lime-900 font-black text-xs tracking-wider">MISIÓN COMPLETADA</span>
            <h2 class="text-4xl md:text-6xl font-black mt-4">¡Tablero recuperado!</h2>
            <p id="finalMessage" class="text-slate-600 text-lg mt-4"></p>

            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mt-7">
              <div class="rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-white p-4">
                <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase">Puntaje</div>
                <div id="finalScore" class="text-3xl font-black text-lime-300">100</div>
              </div>
              <div class="rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-white p-4">
                <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase">Tiempo</div>
                <div id="finalTime" class="text-2xl font-black text-cyan-300">00:00</div>
              </div>
              <div class="rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-white p-4">
                <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase">Pistas</div>
                <div id="finalHints" class="text-3xl font-black text-amber-300">0</div>
              </div>
              <div class="rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-white p-4">
                <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase">Errores</div>
                <div id="finalWrong" class="text-3xl font-black text-rose-300">0</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="mt-7 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
              <button id="downloadCert" class="rounded-2xl px-6 py-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-700 to-fuchsia-600 text-white font-black">⬇ Descargar certificado PDF</button>
              <button id="playAgain" class="rounded-2xl px-6 py-4 bg-slate-950 text-white font-black">↻ Jugar otra vez</button>
            </div>
            <p id="pdfStatus" class="hidden mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-violet-700"></p>
          </div>

          <div id="certificatePreview" class="rounded-[2rem] bg-white border-[10px] border-double border-slate-900 p-6 md:p-8 shadow-2xl text-center">
            <div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[.28em] text-violet-700 font-black">Certificado de Logro</div>
            <div class="w-20 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 via-fuchsia-500 to-lime-500 mx-auto my-5"></div>
            <div class="text-5xl">🏆</div>
            <div class="mt-4 text-slate-500">Se reconoce a</div>
            <div id="certName" class="text-3xl font-black mt-1">Estudiante</div>
            <p class="mt-4 text-slate-600">por completar satisfactoriamente el Escape Room</p>
            <div class="font-black text-xl mt-1">“Operación Compras Estratégicas”</div>
            <div class="mt-5 inline-flex gap-5 px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-white">
              <div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400">PUNTAJE</div><div id="certScore" class="text-2xl font-black text-lime-300">100/100</div></div>
              <div><div class="text-xs text-slate-400">TIEMPO</div><div id="certTime" class="text-2xl font-black text-cyan-300">00:00</div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="mt-7 text-sm text-slate-500">Gestión Logística Estratégica · Gestión de Compras</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <!-- Feedback toast -->
  <div id="toast" class="fixed z-50 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bottom-5 max-w-[92vw] hidden">
    <div id="toastInner" class="rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 font-bold shadow-2xl border"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Hint modal -->
  <div id="hintModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden modal-bg items-center justify-center p-4">
    <div class="max-w-lg w-full rounded-[2rem] bg-white text-slate-900 p-6 md:p-8 shadow-2xl">
      <div class="flex justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div class="text-amber-600 font-black text-xs tracking-[.2em]">PISTA ACTIVADA · −5 PUNTOS</div>
          <h3 class="text-2xl font-black mt-1">Ayuda táctica</h3>
        </div>
        <button id="closeHint" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-100 font-black">✕</button>
      </div>
      <p id="hintText" class="mt-5 text-slate-700 leading-relaxed"></p>
      <button id="hintOk" class="mt-6 w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 font-black">VOLVER AL RETO</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Timeout modal -->
  <div id="timeModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden modal-bg items-center justify-center p-4">
    <div class="max-w-md w-full rounded-[2rem] bg-white text-slate-900 p-7 shadow-2xl text-center">
      <div class="text-5xl">⏱️</div>
      <h3 class="text-3xl font-black mt-3">Tiempo agotado</h3>
      <p class="mt-3 text-slate-600">Puedes continuar para completar el aprendizaje, pero el cronómetro ya no sumará tiempo.</p>
      <button id="continueAfterTime" class="mt-6 w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 text-white font-black">CONTINUAR MISIÓN</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
(() => {
  const STORAGE = 'escape_compras_3948_v1';
  const TOTAL_ROOMS = 6;
  const START_SECONDS = 15 * 60;

  const roomMeta = [
    ['01','Centro de Mando','Estructuras de Compras'],
    ['02','Sala de Funciones','Sourcing · Transaccional · Gerencial'],
    ['03','Alerta de Segregación','Separación de funciones'],
    ['04','Laboratorio del Gasto','Proceso Spend Analysis'],
    ['05','Radar de Gasto','Conceptos clave'],
    ['06','Código Kraljic','Puerta al Tema 11']
  ];

  const hints = {
    1: 'Centralizado concentra estrategia y ejecución; descentralizado prioriza cercanía y rapidez local; Center-Led combina estrategia/contratos centrales con ejecución local dentro de un marco.',
    2: 'Sourcing analiza y negocia; Transaccional procesa la operación diaria; Gerencial define políticas, estrategias, presupuesto, indicadores y riesgos.',
    3: 'El riesgo aparece cuando una sola persona controla varias etapas incompatibles. En este reto, todas las acciones listadas son parte del escenario de concentración riesgosa descrito en el módulo.',
    4: 'La definición de Spend Analysis enumera cuatro acciones consecutivas: primero se reúnen datos; luego se limpian; después se agrupan; finalmente se interpretan.',
    5: 'Maverick = fuera de política/contrato. Tail = muchas compras pequeñas. Fragmentación = misma categoría entre muchos proveedores sin estrategia. Concentración = demasiada dependencia de pocos proveedores.',
    6: 'La diapositiva siguiente al análisis del gasto introduce un modelo estratégico cuyo apellido comienza con K.'
  };

  const defaultState = () => ({
    started:false,
    student:'',
    currentRoom:1,
    completed:[],
    score:100,
    hintsUsed:0,
    wrongAttempts:0,
    startTs:null,
    remaining:START_SECONDS,
    timedOut:false,
    finished:false,
    endTs:null,
    sound:true
  });

  let state = loadState();
  let timerHandle = null;
  let dragId = null;

  function loadState(){
    try{
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);
      if(!raw) return defaultState();
      return {...defaultState(), ...JSON.parse(raw)};
    }catch(e){ return defaultState(); }
  }
  function saveState(){ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, JSON.stringify(state)); }
  function clampScore(){ state.score = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, state.score)); }
  function penalize(points){
    state.score -= points;
    clampScore();
    saveState();
    updateHeader();
  }
  function wrong(room, message='Revisa la lógica del reto e inténtalo nuevamente.'){
    state.wrongAttempts++;
    penalize(2);
    tone('wrong');
    toast('❌ '+message+'  −2 puntos. Puedes corregir o continuar.', false);
    const scene = document.getElementById('scene'+room);
    if(scene){ scene.classList.remove('shake'); void scene.offsetWidth; scene.classList.add('shake'); }
    showContinueButton(room);
  }

  function showContinueButton(room){
    const scene = document.getElementById('scene'+room);
    if(!scene || scene.querySelector('.continueBtn')) return;
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'continueBtn mt-3 w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 py-4 font-black transition';
    btn.textContent = room < TOTAL_ROOMS ? 'CONTINUAR A LA SIGUIENTE HABITACIÓN →' : 'FINALIZAR MISIÓN →';
    btn.addEventListener('click',()=>skipRoom(room));
    const target = scene.querySelector('.checkBtn:last-of-type') || scene.querySelector('.checkBtn');
    if(target) target.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', btn);
    else scene.appendChild(btn);
  }

  function skipRoom(room){
    if(!state.completed.includes(room)){
      state.completed.push(room);
      state.currentRoom = Math.min(TOTAL_ROOMS, room+1);
      saveState();
    }
    updateHeader();
    renderRoomMap();
    tone('success');
    toast('➡️ Avanzas con la penalización aplicada. El reto queda registrado como no resuelto.', true);
    if(room < TOTAL_ROOMS) setTimeout(()=>showScene('scene'+(room+1)),500);
    else setTimeout(()=>finishGame(),500);
  }
  function correct(room, message){
    if(!state.completed.includes(room)){
      state.completed.push(room);
      state.currentRoom = Math.min(TOTAL_ROOMS, room+1);
      saveState();
    }
    tone('success');
    toast('✅ '+message, true);
    updateHeader();
    renderRoomMap();
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(room < TOTAL_ROOMS) showScene('scene'+(room+1));
      else finishGame();
    }, 950);
  }

  function syncMusic(){
    const music=document.getElementById('bgMusic');
    if(!music) return;
    music.volume=0.18;
    if(state.sound && state.started && !state.finished){
      const p=music.play();
      if(p && typeof p.catch==='function') p.catch(()=>{});
    } else {
      music.pause();
    }
  }

  function tone(kind){
    if(!state.sound) return;
    try{
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      const ctx = new AC();
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      const now = ctx.currentTime;
      if(kind==='success'){
        osc.type='sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(520,now);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880,now+.22);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.11,now);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+.35);
      } else {
        osc.type='sawtooth';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(190,now);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(95,now+.22);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.08,now);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+.3);
      }
      osc.start(now); osc.stop(now+.36);
    }catch(e){}
  }

  function toast(msg, ok=true){
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
    const inner = document.getElementById('toastInner');
    inner.textContent = msg;
    inner.className = 'rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 font-bold shadow-2xl border ' + (ok
      ? 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-100 border-emerald-400/30'
      : 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-100 border-rose-400/30');
    toast.classList.remove('hidden');
    clearTimeout(toast._t);
    toast._t = setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.add('hidden'), 2600);
  }

  function showScene(id){
    document.querySelectorAll('.scene').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if(el){ el.classList.add('active'); window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}); }
  }

  function updateHeader(){
    const done = state.completed.length;
    document.getElementById('progressLabel').textContent = `${done} de ${TOTAL_ROOMS} habitaciones`;
    document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = `${(done/TOTAL_ROOMS)*100}%`;
    document.getElementById('scoreTop').textContent = `${state.score} pts`;
    ['soundBtn','soundBtnDesk'].forEach(id=>{
      const b=document.getElementById(id); if(b) b.textContent=state.sound?'🔊':'🔇';
    });
  }

  function renderRoomMap(){
    const box = document.getElementById('roomMap');
    if(!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = roomMeta.map((r,i)=>{
      const room=i+1, done=state.completed.includes(room), open= room===1 || state.completed.includes(room-1);
      return `<div class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-2xl ${done?'bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-200':open?'bg-cyan-50 border border-cyan-100':'bg-slate-100 opacity-55'}">
        <div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl grid place-items-center font-black ${done?'bg-emerald-500 text-white':open?'bg-cyan-500 text-white':'bg-slate-300 text-slate-600'}">${done?'✓':open?r[0]:'🔒'}</div>
        <div><div class="font-black">${r[1]}</div><div class="text-xs text-slate-500">${r[2]}</div></div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function updateTimer(){
    const timer = document.getElementById('timer');
    const box = document.getElementById('timerBox');
    if(!state.started || state.finished){ renderTime(state.remaining); return; }

    if(state.startTs && !state.timedOut){
      const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now()-state.startTs)/1000);
      state.remaining = Math.max(0, START_SECONDS - elapsed);
    }
    renderTime(state.remaining);
    if(state.remaining <= 60 && state.remaining>0) box.classList.add('timer-danger');
    else box.classList.remove('timer-danger');

    if(state.remaining<=0 && !state.timedOut){
      state.timedOut=true;
      state.remaining=0;
      saveState();
      document.getElementById('timeModal').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('timeModal').classList.add('flex');
      tone('wrong');
    }
  }
  function renderTime(sec){
    sec=Math.max(0,sec||0);
    const m=Math.floor(sec/60), s=sec%60;
    document.getElementById('timer').textContent=`${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  }
  function startTimer(){
    clearInterval(timerHandle);
    updateTimer();
    timerHandle=setInterval(()=>{ updateTimer(); if(state.started && !state.finished) saveState(); },1000);
  }

  function startGame(){
    const name=document.getElementById('studentName').value.trim();
    if(!name){
      document.getElementById('nameError').classList.remove('hidden'); return;
    }
    document.getElementById('nameError').classList.add('hidden');
    state = defaultState();
    state.started=true; state.student=name; state.startTs=Date.now();
    saveState(); updateHeader(); renderRoomMap(); startTimer();
    syncMusic();
    showScene('scene1'); tone('success');
  }

  function useHint(room){
    if(!state.started || state.finished) return;
    if(state.score<=1){ toast('No quedan puntos disponibles para comprar pistas.',false); return; }
    state.hintsUsed++; penalize(5);
    document.getElementById('hintText').textContent=hints[room];
    const modal=document.getElementById('hintModal');
    modal.classList.remove('hidden'); modal.classList.add('flex');
    tone('success');
  }

  // Room 1
  const r1 = [
    {q:'La sede corporativa negocia volúmenes globales, define políticas uniformes y concentra la especialización.', a:'centralizado'},
    {q:'Cada unidad local compra con rapidez y flexibilidad según su realidad operativa, aunque existe riesgo de fragmentación.', a:'descentralizado'},
    {q:'Una unidad central define estrategia y contratos; las sedes locales ejecutan dentro de ese marco.', a:'center-led'}
  ];
  function renderR1(){
    document.getElementById('r1Questions').innerHTML = r1.map((x,i)=>`
      <div class="rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200 p-4">
        <div class="font-bold">${i+1}. ${x.q}</div>
        <div class="grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-3">
          ${[['centralizado','Centralizado'],['descentralizado','Descentralizado'],['center-led','Center-Led']].map(c=>`
            <button class="r1c choice rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 px-3 py-3 text-sm font-bold hover:border-cyan-400 transition" data-q="${i}" data-v="${c[0]}">${c[1]}</button>`).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
    document.querySelectorAll('.r1c').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      document.querySelectorAll(`.r1c[data-q="${b.dataset.q}"]`).forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));
      b.classList.add('selected');
    }));
  }
  function checkR1(){
    let all=true, answered=true;
    r1.forEach((x,i)=>{
      const s=document.querySelector(`.r1c.selected[data-q="${i}"]`);
      if(!s){answered=false;all=false;}
      else if(s.dataset.v!==x.a) all=false;
    });
    if(!answered) return wrong(1,'Completa los tres escenarios antes de validar.');
    if(all) correct(1,'Estructuras correctamente asignadas. El centro de mando está estable.');
    else wrong(1,'Hay al menos una estructura mal asignada.');
  }

  // Room 2
  const r2 = [
    {id:'a',text:'Investigar proveedores',cat:'sourcing'},
    {id:'b',text:'Preparar una RFQ/RFP',cat:'sourcing'},
    {id:'c',text:'Negociar y contratar',cat:'sourcing'},
    {id:'d',text:'Emitir órdenes de compra',cat:'transaccional'},
    {id:'e',text:'Registrar recepciones',cat:'transaccional'},
    {id:'f',text:'Gestionar facturas',cat:'transaccional'},
    {id:'g',text:'Definir políticas de compras',cat:'gerencial'},
    {id:'h',text:'Gestionar presupuesto e indicadores',cat:'gerencial'},
    {id:'i',text:'Gestionar riesgos y relación con dirección',cat:'gerencial'}
  ];
  function cardHTML(x){
    return `<div id="card-${x.id}" draggable="true" class="draggable r2card rounded-xl bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 px-3 py-3 text-sm font-bold shadow-sm" data-id="${x.id}">${x.text}</div>`;
  }
  function renderR2(){
    const src=document.getElementById('r2Cards');
    src.innerHTML=r2.map(cardHTML).join('');
    bindDrag();
  }
  function bindDrag(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.r2card').forEach(c=>{
      c.addEventListener('dragstart',()=>{dragId=c.dataset.id; setTimeout(()=>c.classList.add('opacity-40'),0);});
      c.addEventListener('dragend',()=>{c.classList.remove('opacity-40');dragId=null;});
      c.addEventListener('click',()=>{
        // Mobile: cycle card through source -> zones
        const parentZone=c.closest('.dropzone')?.dataset.zone;
        const zones=['sourcing','transaccional','gerencial'];
        const idx=zones.indexOf(parentZone);
        const next=zones[(idx+1)%zones.length];
        document.querySelector(`.dropzone[data-zone="${next}"] .drop-content`).appendChild(c);
      });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropzone').forEach(z=>{
      z.addEventListener('dragover',e=>{e.preventDefault();z.classList.add('drag-over');});
      z.addEventListener('dragleave',()=>z.classList.remove('drag-over'));
      z.addEventListener('drop',e=>{
        e.preventDefault(); z.classList.remove('drag-over');
        if(dragId){
          const c=document.getElementById('card-'+dragId);
          if(c) z.querySelector('.drop-content').appendChild(c);
        }
      });
    });
  }
  function checkR2(){
    let placed=0,ok=true;
    r2.forEach(x=>{
      const c=document.getElementById('card-'+x.id);
      const zone=c?.closest('.dropzone')?.dataset.zone;
      if(zone) placed++;
      if(zone!==x.cat) ok=false;
    });
    if(placed<r2.length) return wrong(2,'Aún quedan actividades sin clasificar.');
    if(ok) correct(2,'Funciones correctamente separadas. La operación vuelve a tener claridad.');
    else wrong(2,'Revisa qué actividades pertenecen a Sourcing, Transaccional y Gerencial.');
  }

  // Room 3
  const r3 = [
    'Crear al proveedor',
    'Seleccionarlo sin revisión',
    'Emitir la orden de compra',
    'Confirmar la recepción',
    'Aprobar la factura',
    'Autorizar el pago'
  ];
  function renderR3(){
    document.getElementById('r3Options').innerHTML=r3.map((x,i)=>`
      <label class="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 cursor-pointer hover:border-rose-300 transition">
        <input type="checkbox" class="r3check w-5 h-5 accent-rose-600" data-i="${i}">
        <span class="font-bold">${x}</span>
      </label>`).join('');
  }
  function checkR3(){
    const checked=[...document.querySelectorAll('.r3check')].filter(x=>x.checked);
    if(checked.length===r3.length) correct(3,'Segregación restablecida. Identificaste toda la cadena de concentración de riesgo.');
    else wrong(3,'El escenario del módulo considera todas las acciones listadas como una concentración peligrosa si recaen en la misma persona.');
  }

  // Room 4
  const r4Correct=['Recopilar','Depurar','Clasificar','Analizar'];
  let r4Order=['Clasificar','Recopilar','Analizar','Depurar'];
  function renderR4(){
    const box=document.getElementById('r4List');
    box.innerHTML=r4Order.map((x,i)=>`
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-sm">
        <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 text-white grid place-items-center font-black">${i+1}</div>
        <div class="font-black flex-1">${x}</div>
        <div class="flex gap-1">
          <button class="moveR4 w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-cyan-100 font-black" data-i="${i}" data-d="-1">↑</button>
          <button class="moveR4 w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-violet-100 font-black" data-i="${i}" data-d="1">↓</button>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
    document.querySelectorAll('.moveR4').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const i=+b.dataset.i, j=i+(+b.dataset.d);
      if(j<0||j>=r4Order.length) return;
      [r4Order[i],r4Order[j]]=[r4Order[j],r4Order[i]];
      renderR4();
    }));
  }
  function checkR4(){
    const ok=r4Correct.every((x,i)=>r4Order[i]===x);
    if(ok) correct(4,'Secuencia reconstruida: recopilar, depurar, clasificar y analizar.');
    else wrong(4,'La secuencia aún no coincide con la definición de Spend Analysis.');
  }

  // Room 5
  const concepts=['Gasto gestionado','Gasto bajo contrato','Maverick spend','Tail spend','Fragmentación','Concentración'];
  const r5=[
    {q:'Compras aplica una estrategia o proceso formal sobre este gasto.',a:'Gasto gestionado'},
    {q:'La compra está cubierta por condiciones negociadas y vigentes.',a:'Gasto bajo contrato'},
    {q:'Una unidad compra fuera de la política o ignora un contrato vigente.',a:'Maverick spend'},
    {q:'Existen muchísimas compras pequeñas que acumulan alto costo administrativo.',a:'Tail spend'},
    {q:'La misma categoría se compra a múltiples proveedores sin una estrategia común.',a:'Fragmentación'},
    {q:'La organización depende económicamente de muy pocos proveedores.',a:'Concentración'}
  ];
  function renderR5(){
    document.getElementById('r5Questions').innerHTML=r5.map((x,i)=>`
      <div class="rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200 p-4">
        <div class="font-bold">${i+1}. ${x.q}</div>
        <select class="r5select mt-3 w-full rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 px-3 py-3 font-semibold" data-i="${i}">
          <option value="">Selecciona un concepto</option>
          ${concepts.map(c=>`<option>${c}</option>`).join('')}
        </select>
      </div>`).join('');
  }
  function checkR5(){
    let answered=true,ok=true;
    r5.forEach((x,i)=>{
      const v=document.querySelector(`.r5select[data-i="${i}"]`).value;
      if(!v) answered=false;
      if(v!==x.a) ok=false;
    });
    if(!answered) return wrong(5,'Completa las seis relaciones.');
    if(ok) correct(5,'Radar calibrado. Los patrones de gasto quedaron correctamente identificados.');
    else wrong(5,'Hay conceptos de gasto intercambiados. Revisa las definiciones.');
  }

  // Room 6
  const r6Choices=['Balanced Scorecard','Matriz de Kraljic','EOQ / Lote económico','5S de almacén'];
  function renderR6(){
    document.getElementById('r6Choices').innerHTML=r6Choices.map((x,i)=>`
      <button class="r6c choice text-left rounded-2xl border-2 border-white/15 bg-white/5 p-4 font-bold hover:border-lime-300/60 transition" data-v="${x}">
        <span class="inline-grid place-items-center w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-white/10 mr-2">${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}</span>${x}
      </button>`).join('');
    document.querySelectorAll('.r6c').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      document.querySelectorAll('.r6c').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));
      b.classList.add('selected');
    }));
  }
  function checkR6(){
    const s=document.querySelector('.r6c.selected');
    if(!s) return wrong(6,'Selecciona el tema que abre la puerta final.');
    if(s.dataset.v==='Matriz de Kraljic') correct(6,'Código correcto: Matriz de Kraljic. ¡Puerta final desbloqueada!');
    else wrong(6,'Ese no es el tema que sigue al análisis del gasto en el módulo.');
  }

  function checkRoom(room){
    if(state.completed.includes(room)){
      toast('Esta habitación ya fue superada. Avanza a la siguiente.',true); return;
    }
    ({1:checkR1,2:checkR2,3:checkR3,4:checkR4,5:checkR5,6:checkR6}[room])();
  }

  function elapsedSeconds(){
    if(!state.startTs) return 0;
    const end=state.endTs || Date.now();
    return Math.max(0,Math.floor((end-state.startTs)/1000));
  }
  function fmtElapsed(sec){
    const m=Math.floor(sec/60),s=sec%60;
    return `${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  }
  function performanceLabel(score){
    if(score>=90) return 'Dominio sobresaliente';
    if(score>=80) return 'Muy buen dominio';
    if(score>=70) return 'Buen dominio';
    if(score>=60) return 'Dominio en desarrollo';
    return 'Misión completada';
  }
  function finishGame(){
    if(!state.finished){
      state.finished=true; state.endTs=Date.now(); saveState();
    }
    clearInterval(timerHandle);
    syncMusic();
    const elapsed=elapsedSeconds();
    document.getElementById('finalScore').textContent=state.score;
    document.getElementById('finalTime').textContent=fmtElapsed(elapsed);
    document.getElementById('finalHints').textContent=state.hintsUsed;
    document.getElementById('finalWrong').textContent=state.wrongAttempts;
    document.getElementById('certName').textContent=state.student;
    document.getElementById('certScore').textContent=state.score+'/100';
    document.getElementById('certTime').textContent=fmtElapsed(elapsed);
    document.getElementById('finalMessage').textContent=`${state.student}, completaste las 6 habitaciones con ${performanceLabel(state.score).toLowerCase()}.`;
    showScene('endScreen');
    tone('success');
  }

  function pdfEscape(s){
    return String(s).replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/\(/g,'\\(').replace(/\)/g,'\\)').replace(/[\r\n]+/g,' ');
  }

  function downloadNativePDF(filename){
    // PDF básico generado sin librerías externas: funciona incluso sin Internet.
    const W=842, H=595; // A4 apaisado en puntos
    const name=pdfEscape((state.student||'Estudiante').slice(0,55));
    const score=pdfEscape(`${state.score}/100`);
    const time=pdfEscape(fmtElapsed(elapsedSeconds()));
    const performance=pdfEscape(performanceLabel(state.score));
    const hints=pdfEscape(state.hintsUsed);
    const wrongs=pdfEscape(state.wrongAttempts);

    const content=[
      'q',
      '0.97 0.98 1 rg 0 0 842 595 re f',
      '0.06 0.09 0.16 RG 4 w 28 28 786 539 re S',
      '0.05 0.65 0.85 RG 1.5 w 40 40 762 515 re S',
      '0.06 0.09 0.16 rg 65 455 712 70 re f',
      'BT /F1 14 Tf 1 1 1 rg 421 487 Td (GESTION LOGISTICA ESTRATEGICA - GESTION DE COMPRAS) Tj ET',
      'BT /F1 18 Tf 0.43 0.16 0.85 rg 421 420 Td (CERTIFICADO DE LOGRO) Tj ET',
      'BT /F2 14 Tf 0.28 0.33 0.42 rg 421 385 Td (Se reconoce a) Tj ET',
      `BT /F1 27 Tf 0.06 0.09 0.16 rg 421 342 Td (${name}) Tj ET`,
      'BT /F2 14 Tf 0.28 0.33 0.42 rg 421 305 Td (por completar satisfactoriamente el Escape Room educativo) Tj ET',
      'BT /F1 20 Tf 0.06 0.09 0.16 rg 421 272 Td (OPERACION COMPRAS ESTRATEGICAS) Tj ET',
      '0.06 0.09 0.16 rg 222 190 398 62 re f',
      `BT /F1 18 Tf 0.64 0.90 0.20 rg 320 216 Td (PUNTAJE: ${score}) Tj ET`,
      `BT /F1 18 Tf 0.13 0.83 0.93 rg 500 216 Td (TIEMPO: ${time}) Tj ET`,
      `BT /F2 11 Tf 0.28 0.33 0.42 rg 421 150 Td (${performance} - Pistas: ${hints} - Errores: ${wrongs}) Tj ET`,
      'BT /F2 10 Tf 0.28 0.33 0.42 rg 421 118 Td (Organizacion de Compras - Separacion de funciones - Analisis del gasto) Tj ET',
      'Q'
    ].join('\n');

    const objects=[];
    objects[1]='<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>';
    objects[2]='<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>';
    objects[3]='<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 842 595] /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R /F2 6 0 R >> >> /Contents 4 0 R >>';
    objects[4]=`<< /Length ${content.length} >>\nstream\n${content}\nendstream`;
    objects[5]='<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>';
    objects[6]='<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>';

    let pdf='%PDF-1.4\n%\xE2\xE3\xCF\xD3\n';
    const offsets=[0];
    for(let i=1;i<objects.length;i++){
      offsets[i]=pdf.length;
      pdf+=`${i} 0 obj\n${objects[i]}\nendobj\n`;
    }
    const xref=pdf.length;
    pdf+=`xref\n0 ${objects.length}\n0000000000 65535 f \n`;
    for(let i=1;i<objects.length;i++) pdf+=String(offsets[i]).padStart(10,'0')+' 00000 n \n';
    pdf+=`trailer\n<< /Size ${objects.length} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n${xref}\n%%EOF`;

    const bytes=new Uint8Array(pdf.length);
    for(let i=0;i<pdf.length;i++) bytes[i]=pdf.charCodeAt(i)&255;
    const blob=new Blob([bytes],{type:'application/pdf'});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=url; a.download=filename; a.style.display='none';
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),3000);
  }

  async function downloadCertificate(){
    const status=document.getElementById('pdfStatus');
    const safeName=(state.student||'Estudiante').slice(0,55);
    const filename='Certificado_Escape_Room_Compras_'+safeName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g,'_')+'.pdf';
    try{
      if(window.jspdf && window.jspdf.jsPDF){
        const {jsPDF}=window.jspdf;
        const doc=new jsPDF({orientation:'landscape',unit:'mm',format:'a4'});
        const W=297,H=210;
        doc.setFillColor(248,250,252); doc.rect(0,0,W,H,'F');
        doc.setDrawColor(15,23,42); doc.setLineWidth(2.2); doc.rect(10,10,W-20,H-20);
        doc.setDrawColor(14,165,233); doc.setLineWidth(.8); doc.rect(15,15,W-30,H-30);
        doc.setFillColor(15,23,42); doc.roundedRect(22,23,W-44,25,5,5,'F');
        doc.setTextColor(255,255,255); doc.setFont('helvetica','bold'); doc.setFontSize(11);
        doc.text('GESTION LOGISTICA ESTRATEGICA - GESTION DE COMPRAS',W/2,38,{align:'center'});
        doc.setTextColor(109,40,217); doc.setFontSize(15); doc.text('CERTIFICADO DE LOGRO',W/2,66,{align:'center'});
        doc.setTextColor(15,23,42); doc.setFontSize(12); doc.setFont('helvetica','normal'); doc.text('Se reconoce a',W/2,82,{align:'center'});
        doc.setFont('helvetica','bold'); doc.setFontSize(25); doc.text(safeName,W/2,99,{align:'center'});
        doc.setFont('helvetica','normal'); doc.setFontSize(12); doc.setTextColor(71,85,105); doc.text('por completar satisfactoriamente el Escape Room educativo',W/2,113,{align:'center'});
        doc.setFont('helvetica','bold'); doc.setFontSize(18); doc.setTextColor(15,23,42); doc.text('OPERACION COMPRAS ESTRATEGICAS',W/2,126,{align:'center'});
        doc.setFillColor(15,23,42); doc.roundedRect(78,139,141,26,5,5,'F');
        doc.setTextColor(163,230,53); doc.setFontSize(16); doc.text(`PUNTAJE: ${state.score}/100`,112,155,{align:'center'});
        doc.setTextColor(34,211,238); doc.text(`TIEMPO: ${fmtElapsed(elapsedSeconds())}`,184,155,{align:'center'});
        doc.setTextColor(71,85,105); doc.setFont('helvetica','normal'); doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.text(`Pistas: ${state.hintsUsed}  -  Errores: ${state.wrongAttempts}  -  ${performanceLabel(state.score)}`,W/2,177,{align:'center'});
        doc.setFontSize(9); doc.text('Contenidos: organizacion de Compras, separacion de funciones y analisis del gasto.',W/2,188,{align:'center'});
        doc.save(filename);
      } else {
        downloadNativePDF(filename);
      }
      status.textContent='Certificado PDF generado. Si tu navegador bloquea descargas automáticas, autorízalas para este archivo.';
      status.classList.remove('hidden');
      tone('success');
    }catch(err){
      try{
        downloadNativePDF(filename);
        status.textContent='Certificado PDF generado mediante el modo compatible.';
        status.classList.remove('hidden');
        tone('success');
      }catch(err2){
        status.textContent='No se pudo iniciar la descarga. Revisa que el navegador permita descargas desde archivos locales.';
        status.classList.remove('hidden');
        toast('No fue posible iniciar la descarga del certificado.',false);
      }
    }
  }

  function hardReset(){
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE);
    state=defaultState();
    location.reload();
  }

  // Events
  document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click',startGame);
  document.getElementById('studentName').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter') startGame();});
  document.querySelectorAll('.checkBtn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>checkRoom(+b.dataset.room)));
  document.querySelectorAll('.hintBtn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>useHint(+b.dataset.room)));
  document.getElementById('hintGlobal').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const room = state.finished ? 6 : Math.max(1,state.currentRoom);
    useHint(room);
  });
  ['closeHint','hintOk'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const m=document.getElementById('hintModal');m.classList.add('hidden');m.classList.remove('flex');
  }));
  document.getElementById('continueAfterTime').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const m=document.getElementById('timeModal');m.classList.add('hidden');m.classList.remove('flex');
  });
  document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(confirm('¿Deseas reiniciar toda la misión y borrar el progreso guardado?')) hardReset();
  });
  document.getElementById('playAgain').addEventListener('click',hardReset);
  document.getElementById('downloadCert').addEventListener('click',downloadCertificate);
  ['soundBtn','soundBtnDesk'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('click',()=>{
    state.sound=!state.sound;saveState();updateHeader();
    syncMusic();
    if(state.sound) tone('success');
  }));

  // Build
  renderRoomMap(); renderR1(); renderR2(); renderR3(); renderR4(); renderR5(); renderR6(); updateHeader();

  // Resume
  if(state.finished){
    finishGame();
  }else if(state.started){
    document.getElementById('studentName').value=state.student;
    const next = Math.min(TOTAL_ROOMS, Math.max(1,state.currentRoom));
    showScene('scene'+next);
    startTimer();
    document.addEventListener('click',()=>syncMusic(),{once:true});
  }else{
    showScene('startScreen');
    renderTime(START_SECONDS);
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
